public.title: Find K Closest Elements
public.description: values is sorted ascending and contains 1 to 1000 integers from -10000 to 10000, possibly repeated. Return k values closest to x, favoring the smaller value on equal distance; sort the result ascending. k is 1 through length; x is an integer from -10000 to 10000.
hints: Rank candidates by distance first and value second.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

javascript.signature: findClosestElements(values: number[], k: number, x: number): number[]

typescript.signature: findClosestElements(values: number[], k: number, x: number): number[]

explanation: Explicitly sorting by the two selection keys then sorting the selected values produces deterministic output. O(n log n) time; binary-search windows are an extension.
